text: Register review result: (1) all seawater-wetted pumps, screens, valves and strainers are listed as super duplex, rubber-lined carbon steel or titanium, consistent with section 4 (strainer elements fixed to super duplex UNS S32750); (2) no equipment in ammonia service is listed with copper alloys; the ammonia storage tanks are fixed to carbon steel; (3) the bronze-fitted fire water pumps and valves (00SGA, 00SGC) are consistent with the fresh-water fire water of DEC-EPCE-0018; (4) the entries without material (00BFT50, 00BFT60, 00SGY10, 10HNE10) have been completed.
